article.title: On Marx, Al-Hallaj and all iIn between
article.author: Editor
article.content: Hadi al-‘Alawi wove together Marx, Sufism and Taoism, and lived what he wrote: no meat, no property, no comfort. A portrait of the Iraqi thinker who chose exile over silence, and whose questions still matter to a generation shaped by the Arab Spring. The post On Marx, Al-Hallaj and all iIn between appeared first on MR Online .
